# Digitalizing for knowledge: How Does Digital Technology Influence Innovation Ambidexterity

**Authors:** Multiple Authors  
**Year:** 2025  
**Journal:** Academy of Management Proceedings  
**DOI:** [10.5465/AMPROC.2025.23170](https://doi.org/10.5465/AMPROC.2025.23170)

**Keywords:** digital technology, innovation ambidexterity, manufacturing, China, radical innovation, incremental innovation

## Abstract

Using longitudinal data of Chinese manufacturing firms (2016-2020), this paper examines how digital technology adoption influences both radical and incremental innovation.
